ModMetaData.name: RimAI.Actions
ModMetaData.author: ZRui-C
ModMetaData.description:
RimAI.Actions turns RimAI dialogue into in-game pawn work.
Features: • Dialogue-to-action matching for movement, combat, medical, social, items, production, animals, and DLC jobs • Per-pawn serial queues and cross-pawn parallel dispatch • Safety toggles, job whitelist, and mental-state gates • Prompt schema injection into the shared RimAI communication pipeline
Gameplay text AI uses the shared RimAI configuration. PackageId is unchanged for save compatibility.
Requirements: Harmony, RimAI.Communication. Optional: RimAI.Communication.Memory for behavior recording.
